name: surform-sdl
description: Syntax highlighting and canonical formatting for Surform's Schema Definition Language (.surdl; .sdl files highlight too) — Format Document pipes the buffer through the surform compiler. SurrealQL-verbatim regions delegate to SurrealDB's official SurrealQL grammar.

surform.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `surform` binary that **Format Document** pipes the buffer through (`surform fmt`). Looked up on `PATH` unless the value carries a path separator; a relative path resolves against the workspace folder. Install the compiler from a repository clone with `cargo install --path .`.
